items.source: IELTS OS · 模拟对话 Part 1
items.title: Joining the city library
items.meta: Questions 1-5 · Notes completion · one word and/or a number
items.audioLabel: 系统朗读适配稿 · 非官方录音
items.audioScript: A student visits the city library to apply for a membership card. The librarian explains that registration is free for local residents. New members need to show one photo ID and a recent utility bill as proof of address. The library opens from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and closes at 5 p.m. on Saturdays. Each member can borrow up to twelve items at once and keep them for three weeks. Renewals can be made online twice before the item must be returned. The student also learns that the third floor has a quiet study room that can be booked one day in advance.
items.audioScriptTranslation: 一名学生来到市图书馆申请借书证。图书管理员说明，本地居民注册免费。新会员需要出示一张带照片的证件和一份近期的水电账单作为地址证明。图书馆工作日早9点到晚8点开放，周六下午5点闭馆。每位会员一次最多可借12件物品，借期三周。续借可以在网上办理两次，之后必须归还。学生还了解到三楼有一间安静的自习室，可以提前一天预约。

questions.evidence: registration is free for local residents.
questions.explanation: 题干改写自原文 registration is free。

questions.prompt: Proof of address: a recent ____ bill
questions.evidence: a recent utility bill as proof of address.
questions.explanation: 定位 proof of address 前的 utility bill。
周六闭馆时间是下午 5 点。

questions.evidence: borrow up to twelve items at once

questions.prompt: The quiet study room is on the ____ floor
questions.evidence: the third floor has a quiet study room

items.source: IELTS OS · 模拟独白 Part 2
items.title: Campus facilities tour
items.meta: Questions 1-5 · Notes completion · one word and/or a number
items.audioLabel: 系统朗读适配稿 · 非官方录音
items.audioScript: A guide welcomes new students to the campus. She explains that the main sports centre is behind the science building and includes a swimming pool that opens at six thirty every morning. Student cards are collected from the administration office on the second floor, not from the reception desk. The canteen serves hot meals until two p.m., after which only sandwiches and drinks are available. Printing credits are added online, and each student receives five pounds of free credit at the start of term. Finally, bicycle racks are located next to the north gate, and locks can be borrowed from the security office with a small deposit of ten pounds.
items.audioScriptTranslation: 一位向导欢迎新生来到校园。她说明主体育中心在理科楼后面，里面的游泳池每天早上6点半开放。学生卡要到二楼的行政办公室领取，而不是前台。食堂热食供应到下午2点，之后只有三明治和饮料。打印额度在网上充值，每学期开始时每位学生有5英镑的免费额度。最后，自行车停放架在北门旁边，车锁可以在保安室借用，需付10英镑小额押金。

questions.prompt: The swimming pool opens at ____ every morning
questions.evidence: opens at six thirty every morning.
questions.explanation: 游泳池早上 six thirty 开放。

questions.prompt: Student cards are collected from the ____ office
questions.evidence: collected from the administration office on the second floor
questions.explanation: 注意干扰项 reception desk，原文说不是前台。

questions.prompt: Hot meals are served until ____ p.m.
questions.evidence: serves hot meals until two p.m.
questions.explanation: 热食供应到下午 two 点。

questions.prompt: Free printing credit at the start of term: ____ pounds
questions.evidence: receives five pounds of free credit
questions.explanation: 免费打印额度是 five pounds。

questions.prompt: Bicycle racks are next to the ____ gate
questions.evidence: bicycle racks are located next to the north gate
questions.explanation: 停车架在 north gate 旁。

items.source: IELTS OS · 模拟讲座 Part 4
items.title: Note-taking methods lecture
items.meta: Questions 1-5 · Notes completion · one word only
items.audioLabel: 系统朗读适配稿 · 非官方录音
items.audioScript: In this lecture, a study adviser compares two note-taking methods. She explains that the linear method, where students write sentences from top to bottom, is familiar but often encourages copying without thinking. The mapping method instead places the main idea in the centre and connects supporting points with branches, which helps learners see relationships between concepts. Research with first-year students found that those using maps revised their notes more often, probably because the layout made gaps easier to spot. The adviser recommends a simple routine: review notes within twenty-four hours, convert one section into questions, and teach the topic to a classmate, since explaining aloud is the strongest test of understanding.
items.audioScriptTranslation: 在这场讲座中，一位学习顾问比较了两种记笔记的方法。她说明，线性方法——学生从上到下写句子——虽然熟悉，但常常助长不加思考的抄写。而导图法则把主旨放在中心，用分支连接支撑要点，帮助学习者看清概念之间的关系。针对一年级学生的研究发现，使用导图的学生复习笔记更频繁，可能是因为这种布局更容易发现漏洞。顾问推荐一个简单的流程：24小时内复习笔记，把其中一部分改写成问题，并把主题讲给同学听，因为大声讲解是检验理解的最强方式。

questions.prompt: The linear method often encourages copying without ____
In the mapping method, the main idea is placed in the ____
questions.evidence: places the main idea in the centre

questions.prompt: The map layout made ____ easier to spot
questions.evidence: the layout made gaps easier to spot.
questions.explanation: 更容易发现的是 gaps（漏洞）。

questions.prompt: Explaining aloud is the strongest test of ____
